title: B1 highlight-radius fix has no durable regression pin — only re-blessable goldens guard the unit consistency
detail: The unit fix is correct (verified: the r1→r2 delta is exactly this one line) but nothing exercises the filter; r1 proved re-blessed goldens bless wrong behavior green (network-wide flash, 47/47).
recommended_fix: Extract the distance test (e.g. highlight_in_range(mid, pos, rad)) and pin the boundary: pipes just inside/outside 8 tiles — a tile_px regression fails it without re-blessing.

title: Predict-dedup test omits the topology-gen re-predict leg — the app's mid-window retarget path stays unpinned
detail: The predicted_gen clause — a player edit mid-window retargets the ring within a frame (main.odin's wiring promise) — is never exercised; only window-dedup stability and force are.
recommended_fix: After the second non-forced predict, bump state.topology.gen and call spawn_fx_predict non-forced again: assert the telegraph recomputes rather than early-returns.
